name: Mazanderani
notes: Mazanderani (مازِرونی) — Northwestern Iranian (Caspian) language of northern Iran, written in the Perso-Arabic (Arabic) script. SKELETON: consonant/vowel-letter table now specified, built from the shared Persian-alphabet consonant inventory and adjusted to the PHOIBLE-attested Mazanderani inventory (glottocode maza1291) already recorded in this spec's `phonemes` field: unlike Persian, laterals and nasals are DENTAL (/l̪/, /n̪/) and ⟨ق⟩/⟨غ⟩ are kept apart as /q/ vs /ɡ/ rather than merged, matching the Caspian-dialect pattern also documented for `glk` (Windfuhr 2009). As an ABJAD, short vowels are normally unwritten, so this table cannot by itself vocalise unvowelled text — the same INPUT CONTRACT limitation documented for `fa`/`ar`/`glk`. STRESS EXEMPTION: no `stress` block is declared; Mazanderani word-stress is not reconstructible from unvocalised Perso-Arabic spelling.
